title: dwg2dxf Unicode argv and filesystem path fast slice
status: implemented; current-host validation passed; native Windows qualification remains open
scope: Use UTF-8 filesystem paths for dwg2dxf input preflight and output existence checks.
On Windows, accept wide process arguments and strictly encode them as UTF-8 before entering the shared CLI parser.
Exercise Unicode input and output paths in the FreeCAD CLI compatibility control on every host.

implementation_notes: The Windows wmain bridge rejects invalid UTF-16 instead of substituting characters.
The CLI preflight now uses std::filesystem::u8path for both input and output.
The test source is generated at an ASCII path, then cmake -E copy stages the same bytes at a Unicode path; generated files remain in the build scratch directory.

validation.diff_check: passed: git diff --check; receipt parsed with python3 -m json.tool

limits: The current host test does not compile or execute the Windows wmain branch.
Native Windows filesystem behavior, Qt-delivered argv, MSVC/DLL/shared/static/relocated packaging, and native FreeCAD open/insert remain unqualified.
This is CLI/path handling evidence only and does not promote DWG/DXF format support claims.
fixture_policy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository; the generated source and converted output remain in build scratch space.
